title: Dm6mania

== Introduction ==
A [[DM6]] only 1on1 tournament organized by [[phil]]. The tournament featured a lot of the best duelers we've seen through the years. It contained quite a lot of drama as [[Griffin]] refused to play [[cage]] in the WB semifinal and after this he was [http://www.quakeworld.nu/news/365/ disqualified] from the tournament. Being the legendary dueler he is it was a great loss, he also showed form by beating later finalist [[Fifi]] 2-0 ([14:5], [13:8]) in the round before.
After losing the WB final to [[Cage]], [[ParadokS]] gave a WO to [[Fifi]] in the LB final because his PC wasn't working as intended.

* '''Running date:''' 13th of July, 2008 - 6th of October, 2008
* '''Website:''' [http://50.22.110.124/oldschool/?sid=2 http://50.22.110.124/oldschool/?sid=2]
* '''Signups:''' 99 players (21 - Russian, 23 - Swedish, 12 Finnish, 7- German, and 10 more countries represented)
